data.title: 阿尔托莉雅 · 午后洗衣房的整齐衣角
data.description: 午后的自助洗衣房里，阿尔托莉雅穿深蓝开衫、白衬衫和裙装，坐在折衣台旁的矮凳上。膝前的竹篮盛着刚洗好的衣物，她双手捏住一条白毛巾的两角，在台面上把毛巾对折，碧绿眼睛认真检查边缘是否齐整。背后的滚筒洗衣机排成一列，窗外日光映亮她的金色盘发与蓝丝带，神情专注而放松。
data.location: 午后自助洗衣房折衣台旁
data.action: 坐在矮凳上，双手捏住白毛巾两角，在台面上对折并对齐边缘。
data.camera: medium shot, eye level, seated environmental portrait
data.promptProse: At a laundromat folding counter, Artoria Pendragon aligns the corners of a white towel with both hands. Sitting on a low stool in her dark-blue cardigan, white collared shirt and skirt, the Fate/stay night knight studies the fold with attentive green eyes. A wicker laundry basket waits near her knees, with closed washing machines receding behind her. Afternoon daylight lights the blonde braided bun, blue ribbon and ahoge. Show one relaxed customer, the towel resting on the counter, no writing.
